notes: Riklin 1996, ESI 15: 68-70. The report covers only a 1992 trial excavation of EB City Wall H, a postern and the parallel brick wall W100 (pp. 68-70). It describes no pool, pit, cistern or grave; the only human trace is a foot imprint in the wall breach. Figs. 67 (location plan, north arrow, 0-30 m scale) and 68 (stone plan, 0-3 m scale) on p. 69 show no water installation or burial. The report is silent on these classes but never states that they are absent, so no explicit absence is recorded.
